title: 第十七章师兄师妹第十八章荡妖队
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
lines: 雨后的天气还算清新，阳光久违地探出身子，烘烤着雨后的残留。
按理说，这不错的天气本该给人带来一段舒适的时间，只不过，原本每天都必然营业的茶馆，今天竟然早早关了门。
这算是闭门谢客吧。
有不少每天都来的熟客，来到茶馆门前，看见这一情景，反倒是困惑地挠挠头，发出疑问：“疤爷今是咋了？”
其实对他们来说，茶馆一天不开门倒也是没什么，只不过就是喝茶喝惯了，突然一天不喝，反倒是有些难受。
他们叹了口气，最后只好落寞地转身离去。
此时茶馆二楼，一间隔间雅室内，静静的坐着一道身影，她白衣似雪，面容庄重，看起来是那般一尘不染，不过手腕处却是系着一条褪色的红绳。
油纸伞收好，摆在一旁的角落，静静地等待着主人。
她看着眼前茶水上冒着的丝丝热气，思考了几秒，最后还是伸出双手握住茶杯。
真暖和。
突然，隔间的屋门打开，走进来一位中年男子，他看起来普普通通，只是脸上有一道疤痕横穿左右。
此人正是疤爷。
疤爷走了进来，手里提着一个茶壶，看了眼端坐的女子，笑道：“冻坏了吧。”
林念真点了下头。
疤爷没有因为女子的高冷而有些尴尬，而是放下茶壶，给了女子一个脑瓜崩。
“跟你说了，女孩子不要这么高冷，嫁不出去的。”
林念真捂着额头，眼神不满地看向中年男人，终于舍得开口：“师兄，不用你管。”
疤爷笑了两下，提起茶壶，给自己倒了杯茶水：“下回你想捞人，记得提前和我说一声。”
他将茶壶放下，抿了口茶水：“你知道我今早一打听，外面的人这么传的吗？”
他嘿嘿一笑：“人传人，添油加醋，已经变成你为了救小情人，在雨里与姜老怪大战三百回合。”
他话还没说完，只觉得一股寒气突然袭来，他抬头看去，瞬间对上了林念真那双冰冷到能杀人的眼神。
他呛了口茶水，不断咳嗽，在接连拍了拍胸口后，才缓了过来。
“好好好，师兄不打趣你了。”
他的神情渐渐变得正经：“这小子，还算不错吧。”
林念真没有回话，也没有动作。
疤爷继续说道：“你要是想真正的整顿宗门，这小子就是不错的帮手。”
林念真低头，慢慢地摩挲着茶杯边缘，陷入思考。
疤爷没有催促，只是耐心等待着。
他知道自己这个师妹的脾性，思考的时候就喜欢摸些小东西，这时候不去打扰就是最好的选择。
几分钟后，林念真缓缓抬头，就听见师兄继续说道：“不过，你之前能听我的意见，想办法把他送去荡妖队，就说明了你当时的想法。”
他又是倒了杯茶：“现在咱们怎么苦思冥想都没用，就看那小子能不能在荡妖队里活下来吧。”
“那里处处是妖兽，可不是那么容易待的。”
content_en:
The weather is still fresh after the rain, and the sun peeks out for a long time, baking the remnants of the rain.
Logically speaking, this nice weather should bring people a comfortable time, but the teahouse, which was always open every day, closed early today.
This is considered a thank you behind closed doors.
Many regular customers who came every day came to the door of the teahouse. When they saw this scene, they scratched their heads in confusion and asked, "What's wrong with Mr. Scar today?"
In fact, for them, it's okay for the teahouse to be closed for a day. They are just used to drinking tea, and suddenly they don't drink for a day, which is a bit uncomfortable.
They sighed, and finally had no choice but to turn around and leave.
At this time, in an elegant cubicle on the second floor of the teahouse, a figure was sitting quietly. She was dressed in white like snow and had a solemn face. She looked so spotless, but there was a faded red rope tied around her wrist.
The oil-paper umbrella was put away and placed in a corner, quietly waiting for its owner.
She looked at the steam rising from the tea in front of her, thought for a few seconds, and finally stretched out her hands to hold the teacup.
So warm.
Suddenly, the door of the compartment opened, and a middle-aged man walked in. He looked ordinary, except for a scar running across his face.
This person is Mr. Scar.
Mr. Scar walked in, holding a teapot in his hand. He glanced at the woman sitting upright and said with a smile, "She must be freezing."
Lin Nianzhen nodded.
Mr. Scar was not embarrassed by the woman's aloofness, but put down the teapot and gave the woman a brain-destroying blow.
"I told you, girls shouldn't be so aloof, they won't get married."
Lin Nianzhen covered his forehead, looked at the middle-aged man with dissatisfaction, and finally said, "Brother, you don't have to worry about it."
Mr. Scar smiled twice, picked up the teapot, and poured himself a cup of tea: "Next time you want to rip someone off, remember to tell me in advance."
He put down the teapot and took a sip of tea: "You know what people outside said this morning when I inquired about it?"
He chuckled: "It is passed down from person to person, and with added fuel and jealousy, it has become like you fighting Old Monster Jiang for 300 rounds in the rain in order to save your little lover."
Before he finished speaking, he felt a sudden chill. He looked up and met Lin Nianzhen's eyes that were so cold that they could kill.
He choked his tea and kept coughing. After patting his chest one after another, he calmed down.
"Okay, okay, senior brother, I won't make fun of you anymore."
His expression gradually became serious: "This kid is pretty good."
Lin Nianzhen didn't reply or make any move.
Mr. Scar continued: "If you want to really rectify the sect, this boy is a good helper."
Lin Nianzhen lowered his head and slowly stroked the edge of the teacup, lost in thought.
Mr. Scar didn't rush, he just waited patiently.
He knew the temperament of his junior sister, who liked to touch small things when she was thinking. At this time, not disturbing her was the best choice.
A few minutes later, Lin Nianzhen slowly raised his head and heard his senior brother continue: "However, the fact that you listened to my opinion and found a way to send him to the Demon Slayer Team shows what you were thinking at the time."
He poured another cup of tea: "It's useless no matter how hard we think about it now, let's see if that kid can survive in the demon team."
"There are monsters everywhere, and it's not easy to stay there."
title_en: Chapter 17: Brothers and Sisters Chapter 18: Demon Team
